correctness.rationale: The king graph is the nonperiodic square-board strong product, including horizontal, vertical and diagonal attacks. Independently generated row-compatible masks for every 1<=n<=6 and exactly reproduced all complete face-cardinality vectors, including 202,841 faces for n=6. Inspected the checker’s central-first vertex-toggle acyclic matching, exhaustive directed Hasse topological sort including the augmented empty face, signed gradient-path Morse reduction, integer row/column unit elimination to zero residual, and independent original-chain F2 ranks for n<=5. Given the specified complete certificates, the boundary-unit ranks imply the six torsion-free reduced integral Betti vectors and n=5 minimal multiple-positive-degree threshold. Euler calculations independently agree for all six cases; no assertion for n>=7 or wedge homotopy follows.
residual_risks: The independent computation checked complete face counts and Euler rather than re-running all 101,331 matching pairs and integral gradient-path Smith steps for n=6; those critical exact steps were inspected in supplied code/certificate but not fully independently replayed.
Finite n<=6 cannot be extrapolated to n>=7 and integral homology alone does not prove wedge homotopy.
